about_the_game:
With the Sherman VC Firefly Pack, you'll get:
Sherman VC Firefly (Tier VI Premium British medium tank) with a Garage slot and crew
  • 14 days of WoT Premium
  • 2D style: "Autumn Wind"
  • 10 Pudding and Tea
  • 10 missions for ×5 XP (Sherman VC Firefly only)

The Sherman VC Firefly is proof that adversity breeds ingenuity. Facing the fearsome German Tigers, the British needed to do something big to survive… That something was cramming the formidable 17-pounder anti-tank gun into the Sherman M4 turret. The idea required creative modifications, but it paid off—this Tier VI medium has great penetration (and took out three German Tigers within 12 minutes in 1944).
With the "Autumn Wind" 2D style, included in this pack, you can ensure your tank looks as good as it fights. This vehicle also comes with 14 days of WoT Premium account.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
